description: This file appears to be a bash script containing common utility functions for system upgrade processes, including file installation, library loading, device identification, and upgrade procedures in an OpenWrt-based system.

methods.name: install_file
methods.description: Copies files to a target directory, handling symbolic links and copying files if they don't exist at the destination.

methods.name: install_bin
methods.description: Installs an executable file and its shared libraries.

methods.name: run_hooks
methods.description: Executes a list of functions with a supplied argument.

methods.name: ask_bool
methods.description: Prompts the user for a yes/no answer, defaulting to a provided value.

methods.name: json_string
methods.description: Escapes a string for JSON encoding.

methods.name: rootfs_type
methods.description: Detects the root filesystem type by examining mounted filesystems.

methods.name: get_image
methods.description: Outputs the content of a file, possibly decompressed based on magic bytes.

methods.name: get_image_dd
methods.description: Streams image content through dd with diagnostic filtering.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Reads and determines the magic word (file signature) of an image.

methods.name: get_magic_long
methods.description: Reads and determines the 4-byte magic value of an image.

methods.name: get_magic_gpt
methods.description: Reads the GPT header magic.

methods.name: get_magic_vfat
methods.description: Reads the FAT VBR magic.

methods.name: get_magic_fat32
methods.description: Reads the FAT32 boot sector magic.

methods.name: identify_magic_long
methods.description: Identifies file types based on magic value.

methods.name: part_magic_efi
methods.description: Checks for EFI partition magic.

methods.name: part_magic_fat
methods.description: Checks for FAT or FAT32 magic.

methods.name: export_bootdevice
methods.description: Determines the boot device based on kernel command line and sysfs info.

methods.name: export_partdevice
methods.description: Finds the block device corresponding to a root partition.

methods.name: hex_le32_to_cpu
methods.description: Converts a little-endian 32-bit hex string to CPU order.

methods.name: get_partitions
methods.description: Reads and parses the partition table from a disk or image file.

methods.name: indicate_upgrade
methods.description: Sets system state to indicate an upgrade process.

methods.name: default_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade using mtd and image data.
